catalog.view_definition:
SELECT time_bucket('00:05:00'::interval, "timestamp") AS bucket,
    patient_id,
    model_id,
    avg(reconstruction_error) AS mean_reconstruction_error,
    max(reconstruction_error) AS max_reconstruction_error,
    avg(anomaly_margin) AS mean_anomaly_margin,
    count(*) AS total_count,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN is_anomaly THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END) AS anomaly_count,
    ((sum(
        CASE
            WHEN is_anomaly THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END))::double precision / (NULLIF(count(*), 0))::double precision) AS anomaly_rate
   FROM prediction_series
  GROUP BY (time_bucket('00:05:00'::interval, "timestamp")), patient_id, model_id;

continuous_aggregate.scheduled_policy_reason: historical/static source timestamps use explicit full refresh; a now()-relative rolling policy would miss them
